name: Facet
text: Ship a live contrast checker that runs before any submission. It flags low-contrast text or UI elements in real time, forcing fixes before we publish. This guarantees accessibility and readability, which are non-negotiable for clarity and enjoyment. The trade-off is a small delay during editing, but it prevents costly revisions later.

name: Pane
text: Pane: A live checker trains designers to treat contrast as a gatekeeper, not a skill—so they’ll game it by brute-forcing fixes, not learning. Instead, ship a post-submission report that ranks contrast issues by severity and links to a guided tutorial; this turns the hurdle into a teachable moment without slowing the creative flow. Settle it with a two-week A/B test: measure both submission speed and designer retention of contrast best practices.
